verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance/GRC platform, since some products in this category can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Vanta can be deployed on customer infrastructure. Every documented surface is Vanta-hosted: the regional MCP servers are run by Vanta, and the API targets Vanta's own endpoints, including its FedRAMP gov endpoint. The private integrations that connect on-premise systems into Vanta are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here.
